Download the config and OS specific archives from the following links and extract them to the same directory
https://mega.nz/folder/NR0ByQgJ#yJJfXdyBg4uRbQzKxD_Vnw

Installation Guide

Step 1
Install the following add-on to disable CORS for firefox
https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/cors-unblock/
Step 2
Activate the add-on from your browser's toolbar
Step 3
Execute midnight_girls, then open the given url address
